subject: Culture
title: Whistleblowing and Loyalty
description: A fast breakdown of Whistleblowing and Loyalty for builders.

hook.text: Edward Snowden is a hero to some nations and a traitor in his own. It depends on which honor code you follow.

buildup.text: Honor cultures punish disloyalty above all. Exposing your group's secrets is the ultimate betrayal.

discovery.text: Omertà—the Mafia's code of silence—isn't unique. Police have 'blue walls' and armies have 'unit loyalty.'

twist.text: Whistleblower protection laws try to override honor codes with legal incentives. The results are mixed.

climax.text: Most whistleblowers suffer retaliation despite legal protection. Group loyalty trumps written policy.

punchline.text: Every institution runs on an unwritten honor code.

quiz.question: What is the Mafia's code of silence called?
